name: Pattern Mining
description: Pattern mining with pickaxes. Cycle through Vertical, Column, Horizontal, Cross, and 3x3 Tunnel patterns with Ctrl+P (rebindable in Controls or patternmining.json). Toggle with /pm. Sneak to mine a single block. Larger patterns cost more tool durability and mine slower for balance, and every pattern's tool wear and mining speed are configurable via patternmining.json. Compatible with Vintage Story 1.22.3.
